── v1.5.0 — Custom theme, unlocked ──
• Position X / Y sliders now go from −100% to 200% for pixel-perfect placement of any photo
• Zoom range extended from 25% to 500% — tiny logos and huge wallpapers both work
• Automatic seamless mirror-tiling behind the scenes: pushing the position or zooming out never shows empty edges anymore (no extra buttons — it just works)
• Liquid-glass buttons, tabs and topbar when a Custom background is active — the whole UI picks up the photo behind it
• 'What's New' screen redesigned and made version-aware, with a full v1.0.1 → v1.5.0 rollup
• Custom theme panel simplified — removed the floating live panel and preset Fit/Position dropdowns in favor of direct sliders
• 'Choose image…' and 'Clear' buttons resized so labels always fit
──  — TikTok bypass, Spotify, Feedback ──
• TikTok bypass — download & analyze TikTok without a VPN, high quality
• Spotify support — single tracks and full playlists (320 kbps, auto folder, skip-existing option)
• Feedback button — send bugs and suggestions to the developer via Discord
• Live user counter with PIN protection (settings-gated)
• 5 UI themes — Midnight, Aurora, Sunset, Rose, Mono + subtle RGB accent
• Custom photo theme — pick any image as the background with Zoom / Blur / Opacity / Dim
• 'Open Save Location' quick button in the topbar
• TikTok disclaimer toggle and tooltip toggle in Settings
• Full quality ladder restored (360p → 4K / 8K)
• Much faster Analyze and downloads (32 concurrent fragments, cached results)
• Live speed & ETA during trim-before-download and conversion
──  — Conversion presets & mini player ──
• Conversion presets — Best Quality (default), Balanced, Fast
• Autoplay toggle in the mini player
• RGB accent option
• Best-Quality conversion uses NVENC / QSV / AMF with visually-lossless tuning
• Trim-before-download starts almost instantly with live progress
• Video format locked to MP4 for After Effects
──  — Trim before download & timeline import ──
• Trim before downloading — pick In/Out on the source and only that clip is fetched
• 'Fit comp to selected layer' and 'Select all keyframes' buttons in the topbar
• 'Import to Timeline' replaces 'Import after download' — drops at the playhead in a 'Downloaded Media' folder
• Filename template locked to protect the naming scheme
• Faster GPU conversion and hwaccel decode across the board
• Local imports no longer re-transcode or duplicate
──  — Update notifier ──
• Built-in update notifier — checks GitHub for a new version, one-click download
• 'What's New' changelog screen shown once after every update
• Encrypted Discord webhook & obfuscated build output
